subject: SIG response: artifact staging manifest + 30m walkthrough
messages:
From: Alice Park <alice.park@finservco.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.inference.com, marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
Cc: ben.thornton@finservco.com
Date: 2028-08-09T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG kickoff — initial artifact ask and walkthrough

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Thanks for agreeing to help us with the SIG questionnaire. To keep downstream procurement moving, we need a compact plan for how you intend to stage evidence (naming convention, owners, expected delivery windows) and a short walkthrough to validate the artifacts before we open the formal review.

High-level asks:
- A single manifest mapping SIG controls to file names + owners (spreadsheet is fine)
- Sample audit log slices for SSO and privileged sessions (last 90 days)
- KMS key rotation proof and the scope of keys used for customer data encryption
- Retention policy excerpts for logs and backups

Can we do a 30-minute walkthrough today or tomorrow? Our procurement lead (Ben) wants to validate the transfer mechanism for sensitive artifacts (we prefer SFTP or a presigned S3 approach).

Appreciate a short timeline and a list of any blockers.

Thanks,
Alice Park
Senior InfoSec Manager, FinServCo

From: irene.choi@redwood.inference.com <irene.chooi@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@finservco.com>, Ben Thornton <ben.thornton@finservco.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2028-08-09T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff — initial artifact ask and walkthrough

Hi Alice — great to connect. Short plan and next steps below.

1) Manifest: attached (artifact_staging_manifest_v1.xlsx). Columns: SIG control id, assertion text, Redwood owner (name + email), artifact filename, evidence type (log/config/doc), delivery ETA. We’ll update the ETA field after the walkthrough.

2) Evidence packaging and transfer: we can do either presigned S3 uploads (preferred for larger log extracts) or SFTP for encrypted zips. Included presigned upload instructions in attachments. Let us know which you prefer for the dev/prod slices.

3) Specifics you asked for: 
- SSO/session logs: we will provide token/session_start/session_end lines with UUIDs redacted as agreed; format in spreadsheet under "logs_format" tab.
- KMS rotation: see redwood_kms_rotation_summary_2028Q2.pdf (attached) + unique key IDs in the manifest.
- Retention policy: excerpt (Retention Policy — Prod Logs) included as link in the manifest row.

4) Owners and collectors: I’ve assigned primary owners in the manifest — Marissa will own audit log extracts, Karthik will own cryptographic material proofs and KMS statements.

5) Walkthrough: propose 09:30–10:00 or 13:30–14:00 PT today; alternatively 09:00–09:30 PT tomorrow. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/999888777 (I can lock once you confirm).

If you confirm a time, we’ll stage a short folder and share presigned uploads for any artifacts you want to push.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Assurance, Redwood Inference

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.inference.com, marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
Cc: Alice Park <alice.park@finservco.com>, Ben Thornton <ben.thornton@finservco.com>
Date: 2028-08-09T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff — initial artifact ask and walkthrough

Looping in a few clarifications from the runtime/crypto side so the artifacts we produce are review-ready: 

- For KMS rotation proof, we will provide (a) key version history export (redacted to omit plaintext key material), (b) an ops change ticket referencing rotation procedure, and (c) an excerpt from our HSM/KMS configuration showing key usage flags. Those three together are typically sufficient.

- For session logs: we'll produce CSV slices with the following columns: timestamp, principal, event_type, resource, session_duration_seconds. We will mark PII columns as redacted; we will provide a mapping doc that explains redaction approach.

- On evidence packaging: please accept ZIPs encrypted with a passphrase we will share via a separate channel (if you choose SFTP) or via an encrypted presigned upload link for S3. We prefer presigned S3 for large volumes because it avoids double-copying. I attached presigned-s3-upload-instructions.txt to the manifest for your ops team.

- Note: any snapshots of production config will be sanitized. If procurement needs a notarized chain or additional attestation, flag it in the walkthrough so we can coordinate legal.

Irene / Marissa: I’ll prep the key history export and a short README that maps each KMS artifact to the manifest row. ETA: 2 business days for the full package after the walkthrough.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Principal, Applied Inference Security
